name: ModifySubscription

parameters.help_en: The region where the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The modified objects for change tracking, in the format of a JSON string. For detailed definitions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html.
The original DbList is overwritten by the newly passed DbList. Make sure that the newly passed DbList contains all the objects that you want to track. Otherwise, tracked objects may be lost. Proceed with caution.
To query the original objects for change tracking, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的订阅对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html。
原DbList会被新传入的DbList覆盖，请确保新传入的DbList数据中包含所有需要订阅的对象，否则可能会导致订阅对象丢失，请谨慎修改。
原订阅对象，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html进行查询
parameters.name: db_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the task ID
